Papa Wheelies Monday Night Road Ride

Portsmouth, NH · Road

Papa Wheelies Monday Night Road Ride is a road group ride in Portsmouth, NH. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Papa Wheelies parking lot. Pace: a 22–24 mph / B 18–21 / C 14–16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 22–24 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Papa Wheelies Monday Night Road Ride group ride

The Seacoast's Monday night road ride, three pace groups from the shop lot. Drop-bar road bikes only. The A group goes as fast as it wants; the C group at 14–16 is the newer addition for people who want the ride without the racing.
